budget.fail_closed_no_key: OPENROUTER_API_KEY must be set in the environment or in .env at the repo root, else the runner raises before any paid call
budget.key_probe: OpenRouter /api/v1/key usage endpoint is queried before spend; abort if cap would be exceeded

forbidden_h1_information: scheduler decisions, groupings, or canonical formulas
any precomputed answer, cell target, or formula string for the live task
archived trajectories, scripts, or outputs of the frozen tasks beyond the static ELIGIBLE shape label used for freezing

h0.definition: Official SpreadsheetBench 2 control harness: bash + view_xlsx + submit tools, Python with pandas/openpyxl/numpy/LibreOffice, official prompt, 50-call budget semantics via runner --control

h1.definition: Same agent surface, prompt, model, and budgets as H0, except every Python/openpyxl workbook mutation executes inside a transparent workbook transaction that captures observed effects into an internal WorkbookDelta and replays them; no new model-facing tools, no prompt changes, no task changes
h1.transparent_layer: pre/post snapshots + WorkbookDelta capture/replay underneath the existing Python surface; lowering opt-in only, SQL hidden

hypothesis: Wrapping ordinary control Python/openpyxl mutations in a transparent capture/replay transaction preserves end-to-end spreadsheet capability (paired official-score parity) while making effects available as an internal WorkbookDelta.

fail_closed: OPENROUTER_API_KEY missing -> RuntimeError before any paid call
slice declares a different model and --allow-model-mismatch is absent -> ValueError
live_run_mechanics.model_preflight: OpenRouter catalog lookup for z-ai/glm-5.3-flash; requires max_tokens+tools support; records catalog and safety (max-override) per-token prices
live_run_mechanics.per_task: one SWE-agent run per task per arm writing to <benchmark-root>/benchmark-runs/openrouter/<run-name>/<Category>-<id>/; per-task ledger entry with prompts, tool schema, model identity, cost and call counts
live_run_mechanics.slice_model_pin: slice JSON declares model z-ai/glm-5.3-flash; runs without --allow-model-mismatch fail closed on mismatch

official_score: per-task official eval score per arm (score_openrouter_run.py over staged outputs)
paired win/loss/tie counts H1 vs H0
paired_deltas: modification delta: cells changed H1 minus H0 per task
regression delta: official-score H1 minus H0 per task
runtime: zero-output failure count per arm (submitted but no workbook / missing output)
runtime-specific failures: capture exceptions, replay mismatches, transaction aborts (H1 only)
exact-conversion rates both directions (H0 output via capture-replay vs direct; H1 delta vs direct write)
